originalContent.body: The gray wolf

sharedPassages.label: 大問3C
sharedPassages.text:
Gray Wolves

The gray wolf is an animal that can be found in North America, Europe, Asia, and other areas. Gray wolves live in forests, snowy places, and other places. Gray wolves used to live all across the United States, but recently, most gray wolves have only lived in the northern areas of North America. In the 1970s, only a few hundred gray wolves lived in the southern area of the United States.

The main reason the gray wolves disappeared is that they were hunted by humans. In the 1800s, humans went to live in the western areas of the United States and cut down trees to build houses. Therefore, the gray wolves lost their homes and had to go to new places close to humans’ houses. They ate people’s pets or animals on people’s farms. Humans did not like this, so they hunted the gray wolves. Then, the number of gray wolves decreased.

This created a new problem in the 1900s. Gray wolves originally ate animals in the forests. However, because there were fewer gray wolves, other animals lived longer. These animals ate many plants. People realized gray wolves helped the forests by eating the animals that ate the plants.

In 1974, the American government made a new rule. The rule said no one could kill or hurt gray wolves. Because of this, in just forty years, the population of gray wolves grew in the southern areas of America. The gray wolves helped the environment a lot. The number of other animals decreased, and the number of plants increased.

外国人の友達（James）からのＥメールを読み，2つの質問に対応する内容を自分で自由に考え，返信メールを英文で書きなさい。語数の目安は15語～25語です。

Hi,

Thank you for your e-mail. My brother tells me that you go to school by bus. I have some questions for you. What time do you get on the bus? And how long does it take you to go to school?

Your friend, James

questions.officialSampleAnswer: I get on the bus at seven in the morning. It takes thirty minutes to go to school. I usually study on the bus.

From: Judy Smith To: Ann Smith Date: December 8 Subject: Winter sale

Dear Grandma, Thank you for giving me a lovely present last month. I really like the wallet! Yesterday, I visited a department store near the station. They were having a winter sale! You said you wanted a brown sweater, right? I looked for one, but I couldn’t find any brown ones. However, I saw a nice scarf and bought it for you! I also bought a coat for myself. Can I bring the scarf to you? Will you be home this Saturday?

Write back soon, Judy

Dear Judy, I am glad to hear that you like the wallet. I found it at a shopping mall next to the museum. Thank you for the scarf! Yes, I will be home this Saturday, and my old friend Linda will also visit my house that day! I have not seen her since she moved to another city two years ago. Do you remember her? You often met her at my house when you were little. You can see her this Saturday if you come here. By the way, will your mom come with you that day?

Love, Grandma

You said you wanted a brown sweater, right? I looked for one, but I couldn’t find any brown ones. However, I saw a nice scarf and bought it for you! I also bought a coat for myself. Can I bring the scarf to you? Will you be home this Saturday?

Write back soon, Judy

From: Ann Smith To: Judy Smith Date: December 8 Subject: Thank you!

Dear Judy, I am glad to hear that you like the wallet. I found it at a shopping mall next to the museum. Thank you for the scarf! Yes, I will be home this Saturday, and my old friend Linda will also visit my house that day! I have not seen her since she moved to another city two years ago. Do you remember her? You often met her at my house when you were little. You can see her this Saturday if you come here. By the way, will your mom come with you that day?

Love, Grandma

From: Judy Smith To: Ann Smith Date: December 8 Subject: Great!

Dear Grandma, Yes, I remember Linda! She was very kind to me! Linda often told me stories when you were cooking in the kitchen. They were so interesting! I want to meet her, too! But my mom cannot come with me that day because she has to work. I will visit you alone by bus. Yesterday, I also found a new cake shop near the park, so I will buy some cakes for you and Linda before I visit your house.

See you soon, Judy

originalContent.body: What did Anna like when she was a child?

sharedPassages.label: 大問3C
sharedPassages.text:
Never Too Late

Anna Mary Robertson Moses, also known as Grandma Moses, was an American artist. She was born in 1860 on a farm in New York. As a girl, Anna worked hard on the farm and took care of her family. She liked to play outside with her brothers in her free time. She also loved making things with her hands. She often enjoyed drawing pictures on paper her father bought for her.

Anna married Thomas Moses in 1887 and lived on the local farm she loved. Even after Thomas died in 1927, she kept working on her farm with the help of her youngest son. But when she got older, it was hard for her to do some things on the farm because her hands hurt. So, she decided to try painting instead. She was already over seventy-five years old then.

Anna painted all the things she loved from her farm life. She often painted green fields, snowy winters, and happy people living in nature. Her paintings were so unique and full of happiness that a lot of people wanted to see them. They felt so warm and happy when they saw her works painted in a simple way with many colors.

Anna kept painting until about 1960. She created more than 1,500 works of art in her life, and her paintings became popular across the country. Even today, many people come to see her paintings in museums. Anna and her paintings show that anyone can try something new at any time in their life.

choices.イ: She had a problem with her hands.
choices.ウ: She did not want to look old.
choices.エ: She did not enjoy living on her farm.

Hi,

Thank you for your e-mail. I heard that you came back from India yesterday. I have some questions for you. What did you do during your flight from India? And what time did you return to your house yesterday?

Your friend, James

questions.officialSampleAnswer: I watched some movies during my flight from India. I returned home at ten o’clock last night. I had a good time on the flight.

originalContent.body: As a child, Ansel Adams

sharedPassages.label: 大問3C
sharedPassages.text:
Ansel Adams

Ansel Adams was a famous photographer in the United States. He was born in 1902. As a child, he could not focus in class and did not like school. Adams enjoyed taking walks in nature and playing the piano. Adams played the piano for over ten years in his childhood and was very good. He wanted to be a professional musician.

In the 1910s, Adams received his first camera. He took many pictures in a large park in the United States called Yosemite National Park. Adams often went hiking in the mountains there with his camera. When he was older, he joined a club of people who worked in the park and went on hikes with them. Adams loved to take pictures of the mountains in Yosemite National Park.

In the late 1920s, Adams decided to become a professional photographer instead of a professional musician. Then he made many books of his photos and sold them. His photos of beautiful nature were very popular. Many people thought the photos were very artistic and were like paintings, so they became popular. Adams worked for many companies and took pictures of new products.

However, Adams did not like taking pictures for companies because he believed photography was an art. He took photographs of nature and showed them in museums. Adams taught many people how to take pictures. In 1980, Adams received an award from the president of the United States to celebrate his life. Adams became one of the most famous photographers.

choices.イ: He went on hikes in the mountains.
choices.ウ: He worked at a camera store.

Ansel Adams

Ansel Adams was a famous photographer in the United States. He was born in 1902. As a child, he could not focus in class and did not like school. Adams enjoyed taking walks in nature and playing the piano. Adams played the piano for over ten years in his childhood and was very good. He wanted to be a professional musician.

In the 1910s, Adams received his first camera. He took many pictures in a large park in the United States called Yosemite National Park. Adams often went hiking in the mountains there with his camera. When he was older, he joined a club of people who worked in the park and went on hikes with them. Adams loved to take pictures of the mountains in Yosemite National Park.

In the late 1920s, Adams decided to become a professional photographer instead of a professional musician. Then he made many books of his photos and sold them. His photos of beautiful nature were very popular. Many people thought the photos were very artistic and were like paintings, so they became popular. Adams worked for many companies and took pictures of new products.

However, Adams did not like taking pictures for companies because he believed photography was an art. He took photographs of nature and showed them in museums. Adams taught many people how to take pictures. In 1980, Adams received an award from the president of the United States to celebrate his life. Adams became one of the most famous photographers.

originalContent.body: What happened in 1980?

choices.ア: Adams showed his photos in museums.

originalContent.body:
外国人の友達（James）からのＥメールを読み，2つの質問に対応する内容を自分で自由に考え，返信メールを英文で書きなさい。語数の目安は15語～25語です。

Hi,

Thank you for your e-mail. I hear that you are preparing for your sister’s birthday party. I have some questions for you. What will you give to your sister? And how many people will you invite to the party?

Your friend, James

questions.officialSampleAnswer: I will give a bag to my sister. I will invite about ten people to the party. I hope she will enjoy her special day.

originalContent.body:
QUESTIONについて，あなたの考えとその理由を2つ英文で書きなさい。語数の目安は25語～35語です。

QUESTION
Do you like eating vegetables?

questions.officialSampleAnswer: Yes, I do. I have two reasons. First, the vegetables at the supermarket near my house are fresh and delicious. Second, it is good for my health to eat vegetables every day.

questions.officialScript:
I have to make a speech tomorrow.
Good luck.
I hope my classmates like it.
1  I took one, too.
2 I’m sure they will.
3 You’re very early.

Could you take this chair outside?
Sure.
You’re so helpful. Thanks.
1 My pleasure.
2 In the garden.
3 Me, too.

Dad, I’m going shopping.
Have fun.
Can I have $20 for new clothes?
1 OK, I’ll get my wallet.
2 Yes, I know that store.
3 No, I don’t need any right now.

Is this coffee for me?
No, that’s Mom’s.
Oh, where’s mine?
1  I had tea.
2 Sugar and milk.
3 Yours is over there.

What time does the concert start tonight?
I’m not sure.
Could you check, please?
1 OK, maybe next time.
2 Right, it’s the same band.
3 Sure, I’ll look on the Internet.

I want to go to the Italian restaurant for dinner.
Good idea.
Have you ever been there?
1 No, I’ve already eaten lunch.
2 I’ve been there twice.
3  I was there on time.

Oh, I want to have dogs, too!
Life with dogs is really great.
How many dogs do you have?
1 Five years.
2 No. This is my first time.
3 Three large ones.

What is Jessica looking for?
She lost her notebook.
Did she look in the library?
1 She didn’t see it there.
2  I like that writer.
3  I don’t know that book.

I’m going to miss the train!
You are meeting Kate, right?
Yes, we’re going to study together.
1 Have a good time.
2 About ten minutes.
3  It’s Friday.

Let’s eat at the Japanese restaurant tomorrow.
Shall we invite some other people, too?
Can your friends come?
1  I already have plans.
2  I’ll ask the waiter.
3  I think they can.

The Japanese speech contest is on Friday, right?
Yeah. I’m looking forward to it.
Me, too. My speech is about Japanese food.
Mine is about Japanese music.
Question: What are they looking forward to?

Let’s clean up the kitchen!
I’ll put the glass bottles in this plastic bag.
Thanks.  I’ll recycle the orange juice cans.
We’ll be finished soon!
Question: What will the girl recycle?

I’m going to my cousin’s house to play chess after school. Can you come?
No, I have a violin lesson this afternoon.
Well, let’s get ice cream together this weekend, then.
OK.
Question: What will the girl do after school today?

Are you joining the tennis club, Janet?
Not this year. I’m going to try the cooking club.
Sounds fun.  I’ll join the speech club.
That’s nice.
Question: Which club will Janet join?

Mom, let’s go to the swimming pool on Sunday afternoon.
On Sundays, it’s only open in the morning.
Let’s go on Saturday, then.
OK.
Question: When is the pool closed?

Do you want to go to the art museum this weekend, Sarah?
Sorry, Brian. I’m going to the science museum with my family.
That sounds fun.
Maybe we can go next weekend.
Question: Where is Sarah going this weekend?

Is your piano concert next Friday?
No.  It’s next Saturday.  I practice hard every Sunday.
Can I come?
Of course.  It’ll start at 6:30 p.m. at the community center.
Question: When is the girl’s piano concert?

Let’s go to the park next to the train station.
OK. Let’s walk.
It’s too far to walk. How about riding our bikes?
Good idea.
Question: How will they go to the park?

Emily, do you like reading books?
Yes, I usually go to the library on Saturday mornings.
Really?  I always go on Wednesday afternoons.
Maybe we can meet there sometime.
Question: When does Emily usually go to the library?

How was your summer camp?
Great.  I met many interesting people.
How long was it?
Five days. Next year, I’ll go to a two-week camp.
Question: How long was the boy’s summer camp?

My mom gave me two tickets to a soccer game for my birthday, but now I can’t find them.
The game is next Saturday, so I need to find them before then.
Question: What is the boy’s problem?

I like to make clothes. Last week, I made a red skirt. My mother helped me, and it took me
four days. Next time, I want to make a dress.
Question: What is the girl talking about?

One of my favorite things is my yellow pencil case. My grandfather gave it to me when I
was six. I’m 15 now, so I’ve used it for nine years.
Question: When did the girl get the pencil case?

I had fun in Europe. In London, I took a bus tour and made some new friends. In Paris, I
visited a beautiful church.  I hope to go back again soon.
Question: What did the woman do in Paris?

Today, I visited my friend in the hospital.  I wanted to arrive at ten, but I was late because I
got on a Blue Line train. Only Green Line trains go to the hospital.
Question: Why was the woman late?

printedChoices.ア: She got on the wrong train.
printedChoices.イ: She couldn’t find the train station.
printedChoices.エ: She had to e-mail her friend.

Mark is very busy on weekdays. He works until the late afternoon every day. He doesn’t
have time to go fishing after work, so he goes on Saturday mornings.
Question: When does Mark go fishing?

Laura’s birthday is January 23.  This year, I’m going to buy a birthday present for her on
January 21. We will have a party at Laura’s house on January 22.
Question: When will Laura have a party this year?

This restaurant is perfect for people who want to try new food. We offer various kinds of
food, like Italian, Spanish, and American. We have a German lunch special today. All meals
come with a drink and salad.
Question: What is today’s lunch special?

Peter lives in a small town. Last week, his cousin from New York visited him. She was on
vacation with her family. Peter took her to the local museum.
Question: What did Peter do with his cousin?

printedChoices.ア: They moved to a small town.
